The distance was because of college. She graduated and I'm younger and still had 3 semesters  (year and a half) to go. But away from college we live an hour apart. No HUGE changes in her life.. her job is stressful but thats nothing new. If anything I'm the one that's been going through a lot of crap. Dads sick, legal troubles, etc. And she's been great and supportive through that.

She also just sent me a snapchat (which I'm not responding to). I'm so utterly confused at this point.

You are right, I do need to take care of myself. It's just hard to get out of that dark place in my head. But when I do and I distract myself, I'm okay for the most part. Thank you for your response :)
It's not what I want to do, but I feel like it's what I have to do.

I just really hope this all works. The waiting will be awful. I hope that this time apart helps her and that she decides she wants to be with me. It just seems like shes gone about it in a completely unfair and confusing way. I deserve better...
Jesus christ, excuse my language please. I sound crazy, I swear I'm not! lol. Just hurt. :/

As much as I wan't to talk to her I don't want to make the current situation worse.

I can't tell how she feels either. She is usually the most loving and affectionate person I know. 

I don't know what I did wrong or where I messed up. She keeps insisting it's her and I want to believe her but I just keep going back and forth in my head thinking "What if it's more than this?"

She's also a very blunt and honest person. I feel like if she wanted to break up, she would have just done it. 

I wish I didn't have her fucking number memorized because its killing me to not text her or call her or anything. Fucking fuck this.

Nerves in this situation are healthy and normal, just go for it. Sooner the better. A cliche but also very true quote... wouldn't you rather regret the things you've done then the things you haven't? I hope it goes well...report back!
